author: laziekiki
description: Ask a question, watch the answer stream in with inline numbered citations, and open a docked Sources inspector where hovering a source traces its citation in the answer (and vice-versa). Responsive from desktop split-view down to a mobile sheet, light/dark with a cinematic pinhole toggle, and fully bring-your-own-data: wire your own retrieval into one typed shape. No color, no external assets. React + Tailwind + framer-motion + lucide.
